name: thirdweb legacy Bridge approval misuse
summary: The active implementation behind an obsolete thirdweb Bridge proxy improperly authorized ERC20 orders, allowing one caller to consume a wallet's prior unlimited USDC approval in three transactions.

loss.notes: Gross victim depletion is 865.989600 + 1,770 + 30,994 = 33,629.989600 USDC across three receipts from one attacker, victim, proxy, and call selector. Receipt transfers have no victim inflow or return, and archive balances reconcile respectively as 865.989600 to zero, 1,770.134760 to 0.134760, and 30,994.049120 to 0.049120 USDC. A preceding victim-initiated bridge transaction transferred 0.015080 USDC as a fee and 5.026752 USDC to the proxy; it is legitimate use, not victim depletion from the incident. Transactions after each loss receipt dispose of already-counted proceeds without touching the victim and are excluded. USDC is valued at par.

ageReset.description: The proxy's CREATE2 constructor selected implementation 0xe9bdfbd98b29ea1358f2a9d8cfbd5eb6b5e43c91. Its EIP-1967 implementation slot retained that address from creation through all three loss receipts, no Upgraded event preceded the campaign, and every loss trace delegated to the same byte-identical runtime.

sources.note: Reviewed the three loss receipts and call traces, victim and attacker archive balances, all USDC outflows from the victim through the proxy, the sender's nonce history, the proxy and implementation creation traces, implementation storage and runtime at every campaign boundary, all pre-campaign Upgraded logs, the later disabling upgrade, and thirdweb's post-mortem. The same attacker 0xf2150585c7a80fc09d5a4d02ee675a95225544b8 calls legacy proxy 0x81d57dd01a15bc1c19563693902df621500d4d2a with selector 0xd632d1e2 at nonces 27, 45, and 48. Each trace delegates to 0xe9bdfbd98b29ea1358f2a9d8cfbd5eb6b5e43c91 and makes one USDC transferFrom from victim 0xd0c231a8dec99ba56fc2f58c0785557fdaf4059e to the attacker: 865.989600, 1,770, and 30,994 USDC. The receipt sum and archive deltas agree exactly at 33,629.989600 USDC with no victim inflow or return. The only earlier victim outflow through this proxy is self-initiated transaction 0x851fb17f...fa9a0, which transfers 0.015080 USDC to the fee receiver and 5.026752 USDC to the proxy as legitimate bridge use; it is excluded. Intervening and following transactions dispose of already-counted proceeds and do not touch the victim. The proxy is CREATE2-created by factory 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c in transaction 0xb88618db...ede86 at block 22132362 index 145, timestamp 1743007499. Its constructor sets the EIP-1967 implementation slot to 0xe9bdfbd98b29ea1358f2a9d8cfbd5eb6b5e43c91; the slot is unchanged immediately before all three loss receipts and no Upgraded event exists before the last one. The 6,594-byte implementation runtime hashes to 0xe1c6119eb1ecee5a94765adb1ad60b73d8d4d166ea9c7728ea660f461dafd32f at deployment, activation, and each pre-loss boundary. A disabling upgrade occurs only after the campaign. The first loss is block 22244922 index 99, timestamp 1744365119, so code age is 1744365119 - 1743007499 = 1,357,620 seconds. This corrects the imported lead from the December disclosure date and more-than-$30,000 estimate to the full three-receipt campaign.
